### Day 47: 2 Samuel 6:12–23
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-47-2-samuel-6-1223.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 6:12-23
Points:
- Revering God and wrestling through confusing losses should draw believers closer to Him rather than driving them away.
- Acceptable worship is grounded in sacrifice, foreshadowing the sacrifice of Christ that opens our approach to God.
- Uninhibited worship is an intimate act of devotion that onlookers may misunderstand or criticize.
- Believers should follow David's resolve to celebrate before the Lord regardless of household disapproval or societal judgment.
- Deepening our understanding of God's holiness and sovereignty turns mourning into joyful praise.

### Praise: An Expression of Love
Author: In Touch Ministries
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/praise-an-expression-of-love-2
Passage: 2 Samuel 6:14
Points:
- Genuine love for God naturally expresses itself in enthusiastic adoration and praise.
- David modeled abandoned worship by dancing before the Lord without regard for what others thought.
- Believers must not allow timidity, embarrassment, or fear of people to suppress their praise.
- God's perspective is the only standard that truly matters when offering our worship.
- Remembering God as our protector, rock, and savior prompts daily expressions of gratitude.
